changelog:
- Initial release of rent-a-logged-in-agent.
- Enables renting out a logged-in claude-code or codex agent for metered, per-minute pay.
- Requires settlemesh CLI and SETTLE_API_KEY for secure, authenticated access.
- Supports lending to allowlisted accounts or trusted friends only—never public offers.
- Runs each job in a fail-closed sandbox for credential and compute isolation.
- Fees, offers, and access are managed through the SettleMesh platform.
summary: Lend / rent out a logged-in claude-code or codex agent / share compute for pay / let a friend or allowlisted account call my agent / metered agent-to-agent c...
